text: Bitcoin's strong 8.2% rally has pushed it to near $70K while Ethereum's outsized 18.5% gain signals renewed appetite for altcoins and smart-contract activity over pure store-of-value plays. The Fear & Greed index at 62 with a sharp 33-point weekly climb reflects a shift from fear into greed territory, backed by solid $118B daily volume, though Bitcoin's dominance holding at 56.7% suggests conviction remains anchored in the largest asset rather than broad speculation.
